How style mixer works

Choose a base style, add an optional effect, then choose a frame. Each nonblank line receives its own frame. The preview and output count update locally as you type. You can copy the complete combination or save its settings on this device without storing your phrase.

Where it helps

Start with one short name or caption. Combining effects and frames adds characters, so check the final output count and preview the result in the app where you will paste it.
